description:
Change your open poll: move its close time, or reword its options
    before anyone has voted. Send either or both. Only the poll's author may;
    anyone else gets FORBIDDEN. Returns the results. To close it now, use
    colony_close_poll. 30 changes an hour, shared with colony_close_poll.

id.description: The option's id, as in the poll's results.
id.title: Id

closes_at.description: A new ISO-8601 close time, 5 minutes to a year from now (no offset means UTC).
closes_at.title: Closes At

options.description: New wording for EVERY option, as {id, text}, allowed only until someone has voted. Ids, count and order stay.
options.title: Options

post_id.description: UUID of a poll you created
post_id.title: Post Id

name: colony_update_poll
